_comment: Snake locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, worst to best); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Player Snake on a {width}×{height} grid.
You control snake {player_id}. Valid moves: '[up]'/'[down]'/'[left]'/'[right]' (or w/s/a/d).
Objective: survive longest or be the longest and get the highest score (turn limit {max_turns} turns).

game_action.invalid_death: Snake {player_id} died due to invalid move.

outcome.survived_win: Mai kunnawa {player_id} ya tsira; duk sauran sun mutu.
outcome.all_dead_simul: Duk macizai sun mutu a lokaci guda.
outcome.outlived: Mai kunnawa ya rayu fiye da sauran.
outcome.turn_limit: Turn limit reached - best score wins tie-break.
outcome.ranking: {reason} Ƙungiyoyin matsayi na ƙarshe (mafi muni→mafi kyau): {groups}
